Return threads for specific 4chan board index

Source: R/get_4chan_board_index.R
get_4chan_board_index.Rd

This function returns all 10 threads from a given board page index, starting from the latest thread

Usage

get_4chan_board_index(board, page, latest_comments = TRUE, cool = 0)

Arguments

board

Character variable of the 4chan board.
Available boards are: "adv", "plebs", "hr", "tg", "tv", "x", "s4s", "pol", "o", "trv", "f", "sp", "mlpol", "mo".

page

Integer of the board page index

latest_comments

Boolean, TRUE: Return opening posts and all replies, FALSE: Return only opening posts, Default: TRUE

cool

Integer (seconds), The 4plebs API includes an undocumented API rate limit for the board index search. For multiple searches a cool-down is recommended , Default: 0

Value

Dataframe with details on all posts on a given board page.

Details

Variables in API output:

thread_id: 4chan ID of the thread the post is situated in
doc_id: 4chan document ID
num: 4chan post ID
subnum: Binary, 1: Ghost Post, 0: Non-Ghost Post
op: Binary, 1: Opening Post, 0: Reply Post
timestamp: Time sent in Posix time
fourchan_date: Time sent
name: Author name
title: Post title
referencing_comment: The post_id this post is quoting
comments: Text of the post
poster_country: Author country
nreplies: Number of replies
formatted: Boolean, Has this post been formatted?
media_link: Download link to the media (e.g. images) that have been shared in the post

See also

modify_url, user_agent, GET, http_type, content, http_error toJSON, fromJSON map, map2 str_extract

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_4chan_board_index(board = "mo", page = 1, latest_comments = TRUE)

get_4chan_board_index(board = "mo", page = 1, latest_comments = FALSE)
} # }
